blocks.text: TARLAC CITY, Tarlac — The Supreme Court, sitting en banc, has denied with finality a motion for reconsideration of its ruling affirming Tarlac City Mayor Susan Areno Yap-Sulit’s eligibility to run for office in the 2025 midterm polls, effectively closing the legal battle over her qualifications as a candidate in last year’s midterm polls. In a notice of resolution dated October 28, the high tribunal rejected the August 6 petition filed by private respondents Amado De Leon and Jay-Ar Capulong Navarro. They sought to overturn the Court’s June 3 decision in G.R. No. E-03037 (Susan Areno Yap-Sulit v. Commission on Elections […]...
